text:
maya: Pitch: two-week "Ops Bootcamp Sprint" webinar (three sessions) for platform engineers. Each session 45m + 15m Q. Focus tracks: Session 1 = "Microbench & Cost", Session 2 = "Routing Patterns & Canaries", Session 3 = "Runbook + Oncall Play". Goal: hands-on labs, quick wins, and a compact runbook for attendees. Thoughts?

liam: Love the sprint framing. Suggest each session ships a tiny repo with 5 copy-paste commands and a one-page runbook. I'll own the routing session.

noor: I can run the microbench session. Plan: 5 slides + live bench demo showing q8 vs fp16, batching vs no-batching, and KV cache impact. I'll attach CSV + 3 eval prompts.

maya: Run-of-show idea for each session: 0-3m host intro, 3-6m quick customer vignette, 6-20m live bench/demo, 20-30m config & ops walkthrough, 30-40m runbook takeaways, 40-60m Q&A (extended to 15 if needed). Keep demos <=6m each.

dave: Ops checklist: reserve a small Dedicated pool for dress rehearsals (2hrs each), enable anonymized traffic replay, pre-provision demo tokens, and confirm recording + captions. I'll draft the infra runbook and rehearsal checklist.

sara: For lead routing propose tags: `bootcamp.session=1|2|3`, `interest=cost|routing|oncall`, `demo_request=true|false`. Nurture flow: immediate repo + segmented follow-up at day 2 (how-to) and day 7 (case studies). Also recommend `utm_campaign=ops-bootcamp-sprint` for tracking.

liam: Demo snippets to include in runbook:
```
# burst profile
redwood-cli gen --model redwood-medium-q8 --profile burst --tokens 512
# set routing threshold
redwood-cli routing set --policy fallback-to-small --threshold-ms 140
# enable kv cache
redwood-cli cache set --mode prefix --ttl 3600
```
Include log stream URL and a one-liner to revert routing.

noor: I'll prepare a 4-slide bench narrative + CSV by Wed and the 3 eval prompts. Will build a tiny script to reproduce the bench in ~90s so it's demo-safe.

dave: Runbook will include an exact host cue under "Failover Cue": "Switching to fallback to preserve latency targets — demo continues." Also add rollback one-liner, infra contacts, and where to watch logs.

sara: Example CRM/tech tagging snippet for handoff:
```
event: ops_bootcamp_sprint
session_tag: bootcamp.session
interests: [cost, routing, oncall]
lead_props: [utm_source, campaign, demo_request]
```
Also suggest adding `lead_score` increment for demo requests.

maya: Rehearsal cadence: full dress 7 days prior, contingency run 1 day prior, host tech check 30m before show. Hosts confirm by EOD Fri. We should run a short chaos test in rehearsal: flip routing at 50% point and ensure failover cue works.

liam: I'll pair with @dave for the chaos test. Please include the commands and expected dashboard graph ranges in the runbook so hosts can narrate what to watch.

noor: For the landing page copy I'll draft a short blurb: "Ops Bootcamp Sprint: practical labs to cut unit cost, keep apps online, and ship a runbook. Get the repo + bench CSV." Will share ASSET links.

dave: ops-bot: calendar: placeholders created for Ops Bootcamp Sprint Session 1/2/3. Reminders set (72h, 1h) for hosts.

ops-bot: calendar: rehearsal holds created (2h each) and infra reservation request sent to eng-infra.

sara: Action items: maya = landing + RSVP page + promo by Tue, noor = bench assets Wed, liam+dave = runbook + chaos test Mon before rehearsal, sara = tag spec + nurture flows Tue. I'll draft the host script and share.
